frozen_requirements.M1_ESTABLISHED_STATE: The activated repair/scar state is directly demonstrated before delayed intervention.
frozen_requirements.M2_DIRECT_PHYSICAL_RETUNING: A delayed physical/mechanical intervention is directly applied and quantified.
frozen_requirements.M3_MECHANICS_TRAJECTORY: The tissue/scar mechanical state is quantitatively measured before/at intervention and after intervention in the same causal root.
frozen_requirements.M4_EXIT_TRAJECTORY: The same root measures lineage/state-resolved activated repair cells before/at intervention and after intervention, including disappearance, apoptosis, clearance, or validated state shutdown. Alpha-SMA must exclude vascular/smooth-muscle contamination or be supported by lineage/state identity.
frozen_requirements.M5_TISSUE_OUTCOME_AND_INTEGRITY: The same root measures structural/function outcome and demonstrates preserved repair integrity.

decision_logic: ADMITTED only if M1=M2=M3=M4=M5=YES in one causal experimental root; NO or UNKNOWN on any item = NOT_ADMITTED.

current_roots.paper: A histological study on the effect of pressure therapy on the activities of myofibroblasts and keratinocytes in hypertrophic scar tissues after burn
current_roots.model: human established post-burn hypertrophic scars; biopsies before pressure therapy and at 1 and 3 months
current_roots.observed_exit_signal: alpha-SMA immunoreactivity decreased by 1 month; myofibroblast population decreased and dermal apoptotic index increased by 3 months; myofibroblast abundance negatively correlated with apoptotic index
current_roots.outcome: scar thickness and redness improved during pressure therapy
current_roots.missing: same-root quantitative tissue/scar mechanical-state trajectory before and after pressure intervention

current_roots.paper: Mechanical forces induce scar remodeling. Study in non-pressure-treated versus pressure-treated hypertrophic scars
current_roots.observed_exit_signal: alpha-SMA-positive myofibroblasts were abundant in non-pressure-treated regions and almost absent in pressure-treated regions; fibroblastic apoptosis morphology was observed
current_roots.missing: quantitative mechanical-state trajectory, fixed longitudinal timing and qualifying tissue outcome/integrity within the same root

anti_fusion_rule.forbidden: Do not combine Kim 2015 quantitative mechanics with Li-Tsang 2015 or Costa 1999 myofibroblast/apoptosis measurements to manufacture a coupling root.
anti_fusion_rule.reason: They are independent cohorts, protocols and causal roots.

best_next_experiment.model: delayed pressure/offloading of established red-Duroc scar
minimum_sampling: pre-intervention scar mechanics and lineage/state-resolved myofibroblast abundance
early post-retuning mechanics plus myofibroblast apoptosis/clearance
intermediate scar mechanics plus activated-cell persistence
late scar architecture, elasticity/strength and integrity
best_next_experiment.preferred_state_readout: alpha-SMA with vessel exclusion plus a fibroblast-lineage/state marker and cleaved-caspase-3 or another validated clearance/apoptosis readout
best_next_experiment.goal: test whether a measured mechanical-state shift temporally precedes and causally changes activated-repair-cell EXIT in the same tissue.

claim_ceiling: Mechanical Clock and EXIT Clock are independently causally supported. Their direct coupling remains unproven until one single causal root satisfies all five coupling requirements.
